# revise program for observed rule: dominant consistent columns are vertical markers; complete solid rows are horizontal markers
src='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full monochrome separator rows are the horizontal markers.
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            color = row[0]
            out[i] = [2 if x == color else x for x in row]
    # Vertical marker columns carry the same color in every cell (including
    # rows that are horizontal markers); recolor those marker cells.
    for j in range(w):
        col = [grid[i][j] for i in range(h)]
        if len(set(col)) == 1:
            color = col[0]
            for i in range(h):
                out[i][j] = 2
    return out
'''
